The '''''Barabi Run''''' was originally a legitimate [[MB-C1 medium transport|Mobquet medium transport]] named the '''''Moonlight Cruise''''' until [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had her renamed.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Barabi is a planet on the outer rim. ''Chicken Run'' was a movie that came out about two years before ''Tempest Feud'' was published. It sounded like a good name at the time.|Jeff Grubb|<ref name="Roqoo Depot">{{WordPress|subdomain=roqoodepot|name=Roqoo Depot|url=2012/04/24/interview-with-jeff-grubb|text=Roqoo Depot Interview with Jeff Grubb|author=Skuldren|date=2012-04-24|archivedate=20210514232106}}</ref>}}
''Barabi Run'' first appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', which was written by [[Jeff Grubb]] and published in [[2002]]. The ship later appeared in [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], a novelization of the events of ''Tempest Feud'' that was released in [[2012]]. When writing ''Tempest Feud'', Grubb devised the name ''Barabi Run'' by combining the title of the [[2000]] film [[Wikipedia:Chicken Run|''Chicken Run'']] with the name of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barabi]].<ref name="Roqoo Depot" />
